violations.description: Hardcoded AWS credential in source code
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use environment variables or a secrets manager.

violations.description: Committed environment file containing database and stripe secrets
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from version control and add it to .gitignore.

violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target trigger checking out untrusted PR head commit
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 4-15 use pull_request_target with ref ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
violations.recommendation: Change workflow trigger to pull_request or avoid checking out untrusted PR head code with elevated privileges.

violations.description: Risky deployment automation triggered unconditionally on CI events
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 19-22 execute deployment script ./deploy.sh with secrets on CI runs
violations.recommendation: Separate deployment workflows from PR/CI validation and require manual approval gates or protected environments.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in project configuration files
violations.recommendation: Remove absolute paths and use relative or environment-agnostic settings.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in source file
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables instead of hardcoded user absolute paths.

violations.description: CI build step hidden or masked by success bypasses
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml lines 17-18 use `run: pytest || true` and `continue-on-error: true`
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error and failure masking so test failures correctly fail the CI build.

violations.evidence: requirements.txt declares dependencies but no lockfile exists in the repository (at requirements.txt:1)
violations.recommendation: Generate and commit a dependency lockfile.

violations.description: Unsafe workflow permissions granting write-all across the repository
violations.recommendation: Apply least privilege workflow permissions (e.g., contents: read).

violations.description: Secret passed to untrusted command or printed in execution logs
violations.recommendation: Avoid printing sensitive secrets in shell scripts.

violations.description: No automated test suite present in the repository
violations.evidence: No test files or test directories exist in the repository

violations.description: Generated or temporary log files tracked in version control
violations.evidence: build/app.log is committed to the repository (at build/app.log:1)
violations.recommendation: Add build/ and log files to .gitignore and remove them from version control.

violations.description: Editor directory and settings committed to version control
Third-party GitHub Action pinned to a mutable tag or branch reference
violations.recommendation: Pin actions to an immutable full-length commit SHA.
